subject: Physics
question: A coach travels 200 km in 3 hours. Calculate its average speed in km h⁻¹ and in m s⁻¹.
response_text:
Average speed = total distance ÷ total time
v = 200 km ÷ 3 h = 67 km h⁻¹ (to 2 s.f.)
In SI units: 67 km h⁻¹ ÷ 3.6 = 18.6 m s⁻¹ ≈ 19 m s⁻¹
The coach averages about 67 km h⁻¹, although its actual speed varies along the route.
